Primary sources: WMO92.1.4/5/7/8 via ECMWF regulations; NOAA3.0 note1 angular units; ECMWF overview required3–7 sections/repetition; ecCodes2.50.0 horizontal definition signed factors/unsigned values. Exact URLs and independently generated bytes/expectations are in REFERENCE.json. No product output supplies golden values.

ecCodes observations are separate from the normative raw-byte oracle: this Windows2.50.0 installation returns signed negative values for high UInt32 surface magnitudes through both integer and double getters; its forecastTime accessor also reports all-one bits as-2147483647 rather than missing. The product retains the documented unsigned representation and the WMO missing-code rule. No header API change or ecCodes parity claim.

Investigation stopped after these three causes and their direct consequences. Decoder numeric code, sampling implementation, optional old reference harness, templates, accounts, global config and remote publication remain outside these changes. Previous05 numeric regressions and historical24-field/download evidence are reused, not rerun.
